subject: Recap + POC plan: Finlytics trial (success criteria, timeline, next steps)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Bradford <tom.bradford@finlytics.com>
Cc: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@finlytics.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Recap: Finlytics discovery + proposed POC scope

Hi Tom / Lisa —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and a proposed POC plan to make sure we’re aligned before we kick off. I’ve attached a one-page POC scope (POC_Scope_v1.pdf) with the same bullets below.

High-level goals / success criteria (as discussed):
- Ingest and answer questions over Finlytics’ customer support transcripts (30k messages) with <= 2s median latency for 1–2 concurrent users.
- Achieve >= 85% relevance on the evaluation prompt set (we’ll provide a small seed of 50 queries).
- Show cost projection < $0.02 per 1k tokens with recommended batching/quantization profile.

POC plan / evaluation:
1) Week 0 (this week): access & env setup — provide sample dataset, whitelist Redwood IPs, and create temporary S3 bucket. (Owner: Finlytics / Lisa)
2) Week 1: Ingest pipeline + baseline model run — Redwood to ingest sample and run initial indexing/search demos. (Owner: Marcus / Redwood SE)
3) Week 2: Tuning and prompt set evaluation — run evaluation harness against 50 seed queries and iterate on prompts/format. (Owner: Marissa / Finlytics product)
4) Week 3: Final validation + handoff — deliver final runbook, cost projections, and recommended runtime profile for production.

Open items / asks (next steps):
- Lisa: confirm data delivery ETA and whether we can get a 24–48h S3/test bucket.
- Tom: confirm internal stakeholders for the final validation session and any compliance needs (SOC2 evidence) early.
- Marcus: we need sample data schema + a list of any PII fields to redact before ingestion.

Attachments: POC_Scope_v1.pdf (one-page scope).

If that matches your read, I’ll schedule a 30-min kickoff for Monday to confirm access and owners.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0137

From: Tom Bradford <tom.bradford@finlytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@finlytics.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap: Finlytics discovery + proposed POC scope

Marissa — thanks for the clear summary. That aligns with our internal view. A few quick notes: 

- Timeline: we’re tight on the next two weeks due to a product demo on Oct 20. If we can get to Week 2 results by Oct 15 that gives leadership time to review. Can we compress the tuning window by swapping more work onto Redwood’s side?
- Stakeholders: I’ll loop in Priya (product) and Rahul (security) for the final validation — they’ll join the Week 3 review.
- SOC2: Rahul will likely request the standard evidence set; happy to start that thread once we have a firm plan.

I’ll confirm the data delivery with Lisa, but we can likely provide a 48h turnaround for the sample if we have S3 access details. Kickoff Monday sounds good.

Tom
Tom Bradford
Head of Product | Finlytics
Tom.Bradford@finlytics.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Bradford <tom.bradford@finlytics.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@finlytics.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap: Finlytics discovery + proposed POC scope

Thanks — quick tech checklist from my side so we can hit the compressed timeline Tom mentioned: 

Required from Finlytics before we ingest:
- One representative sample file (CSV/JSON) with ~1k rows of transcripts (can be anonymized).
- Data schema or sample mapping (columns, timestamp formats).
- List of PII fields to redact (we can run a basic PII scrubbing step if needed).
- Network allowlist: please add the Redwood IP range in the attached "network_requirements.xlsx" (contains ports/endpoints we use).

Redwood deliverables in Week 1 (baseline run):
- Ingestion into a temporary index and a short demo (search + QA)
- Basic eval harness: run the 50-seed queries and return relevance scores
- Initial cost projection using continuous-batching profile

If you can drop the sample + schema by EOD Monday I’ll prioritize the ingestion so we can get to tuning early next week. Attaching network_requirements.xlsx for reference.

— Marcus
Marcus Lin
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com

From: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@finlytics.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Bradford <tom.bradford@finlytics.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap: Finlytics discovery + proposed POC scope

Hey team —

We can do that. I’ll: 
- Upload a 1k-row anonymized CSV to the shared S3 bucket by Monday EOD (I’ll send credentials once setup is done).
- Attach schema in a follow-up email (CSV column mapping + timestamp format).
- Confirm PII fields — we’ll mark email and phone columns for redaction.
- Rahul (security) is happy to start the SOC2 evidence thread; he asked for the standard questionnaire and a contact to send it to.

Tom — I’ll coordinate with infra to add the IPs in the attached network_requirements.xlsx (Marcus, thanks for sending).

Lisa
Lisa Chen
Data Platform Lead | Finlytics
lisa.chen@finlytics.com

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Weekly status / quick nudge — Finlytics POC kickoff prep

Hi all — quick weekly status and nudge ahead of the kickoff: 

Status:
- Marcus: network_requirements.xlsx sent; awaiting bucket details and sample file from Lisa.
- Lisa: confirmed upload by EOD Monday and PII fields for redaction.
- Tom: confirmed stakeholders; Priya + Rahul to join Week 3.

Next steps (owners):
- Lisa (Finlytics): upload anonymized CSV to S3 and share creds — due Mon EOD (UPDATE: please share by 5pm PST).
- Marcus (Redwood SE): once sample is available, run ingestion and schedule a 30-min baseline demo — target Tue morning.
- Neha (Redwood CS): I’ve looped Neha for any onboarding docs and to sync on success metrics tracking.

If we hit these items Monday/Tue we should be in good shape to compress Week 1/2 and hit Tom’s Oct 15 milestone. I’ll send a calendar invite for a 30-min kickoff Tuesday 10:00am PST (tentative) — feel free to suggest an alternate.

Quick ask: Lisa, can you confirm by noon PST that the bucket will be available? If not, we’ll provide an alternate temporary upload URL.

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Marissa
